note: D -- rules with at least one mutation observed provoking them. May rise, never fall. The entries are in enforce/discrimination.py and are meant to be read; the count alone says nothing about whether they are good.
why: v3.1 Phase 3: sixteen mutations harvested from the fitness suites' own negative cases, which were mutations in all but name -- transcribed to point DISCIPLINE_REFERENCE at the damaged tree and require the TAGGED function to fail, which is stronger than the sibling assertion they came from. The baseline gains a gap ceiling: D rising is not on its own progress, since a release adding four decided rules and one mutation raises D by one and widens the gap by three.
